headline: Two tours today — 1:15 on a house with an unanswered offer and 3:45 on a house that's already sold — while 195 Lake View crossed 72 hours with nothing sent. Nine showings still owe reads and you owe feedback on 7 homes you toured.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 THE 72-HOUR MARK PASSED AT 12:16 TODAY WITH NOTHING SENT. Roberson's conditional $352,500 re-offer has now drawn four Delta letters, three alerts and one task rewritten five times — and not one phone call. A full in:anywhere + SENT + SMS sweep re-confirms ZERO outbound to your seller in any lane for five days. The last contact of any kind was the buyer side reaching him DIRECTLY about the crawl space and getting it answered without you.
hotSignals.action: Call today, not Monday — the next bar is 96 hours at noon tomorrow. Lead with the number, then the competing interest: William K. walked it Thursday and a second buyer is forming off that showing. That competing interest is the only thing that fixes the re-offer's weak spot — the Roberson buyers' own home is still NOT under contract and goes live Monday.

hotSignals.signal: 🟡 THE PERMIT GOT CHASED AGAIN — ON A SATURDAY. Buyer's agent Manda L. (Keller Williams) opened by text at 11:50 AM with 'I know we are on a time limit.' You closed both of Friday's promises yourself by noon and produced the first date anyone has attached to the permit: the City of Hoover final is NEXT WEEK, with a $50 item pre-conceded. The buyers are still described as very concerned and nothing has gone to them in writing.
hotSignals.action: 'Next week' is a status, not the closeout date this file needs — get the actual date from the seller and put it back to Manda in writing, so the buyers read it instead of hearing it thirdhand. Then call the written backup buyer, Kulsum B. (Keller Williams Hoover), who said 'interested: Yes' with no price objection and has now gone five days uncalled. A backup at or near list costs nothing and strengthens every answer you give on the repair request.

hotSignals.signal: 🔴 A NEW BUYER WALKS THE HOUSE AT 1:15 TODAY WHILE THE OFFER SITS UNANSWERED. The live offer via Davis H. (ARC Realty) carries a buyer credit and a concession, and Seth B.'s question about what the concession actually covers is now eleven days old with the corrected net sheet still unsent.
hotSignals.action: Get him the numbers before 1:15, then tell the buyer's agent the house is being walked again today. New traffic during an open offer is leverage — but only if the offer side hears about it and your seller can answer with numbers in hand.

hotSignals.signal: 🔔 THE 9:30 AM SHOWING HAPPENED — first activity on this listing in weeks, at 123 days on market. Buyer agent Christine S., Counts Real Estate Group. Showing #7 all-time on the unit.
hotSignals.action: Nudge Christine for the read this afternoon while it's fresh — PCB feedback on this listing has never come back unasked, and the last read (7/1) was 'not interested.' Then call Jeff B. with the news BEFORE any price-or-reposition conversation. Still no email on file — capture it on the call.
